articles.title: Saylor's Strategy raises cash reserves to $3.2 billion, leaving bitcoin holdings unchanged
articles.snippet: For the second consecutive week, the firm kept bitcoin holdings steady, choosing to use the raised capital to boost cash for paying dividends on its preferred stock.

articles.title: Inside Zcash's new node that targets Visa-scale privacy at 50,000 transactions per second
articles.snippet: The new Zakura client is the first live piece of a plan to take Zcash from roughly one private transaction per second to payment-network scale.

articles.title: Capital B approves 10-for-1 reverse stock split to broaden investor base
articles.snippet: Europe’s second-biggest Bitcoin treasury company said the September reverse stock split should attract more institutional investors to the French company.

articles.title: South Korea eyes September launch for second phase of CBDC pilot: Report
articles.snippet: The Bank of Korea’s CBDC pilot will add two regional banks, new payment features and tests of government subsidy payments using tokenized bank deposits

articles.title: Allbridge pauses cross-chain bridge after $1.65M exploit
articles.snippet: The attacker allegedly used a flash loan and rapid swaps to manipulate the bridge’s stablecoin exchange rate.
